dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans seeking emergency care for acute sexual assault at Department of Veterans Affairs medical facilities, plus VA medical staff and police.
dimensions.evidence: a covered veteran who exhibits symptoms of acute sexual assault... at a medical facility of the Department of Veterans Affairs

dimensions.assessment: Mandates specific clinical capabilities, unexpired rape kit supplies, counseling, and annual training for healthcare and police personnel.
dimensions.evidence: employs a certified SAFE clinical provider or a SANE certified... maintains a supply of unexpired rape kits

dimensions.assessment: Requires supplies, training, and staffing coordination within VA medical facilities without stating specific overall dollar costs.
dimensions.evidence: maintains a supply of unexpired rape kits... training under this subsection

dimensions.assessment: Imposes new directive, staffing, training, and monitoring requirements across all VA medical facilities and police departments.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall update directives of the Department of Veterans Affairs... and ensure that the policies, of each medical facility, and of police... conform

dimensions.assessment: Permanent policy changes with ongoing annual training and oversight requirements across the national VA healthcare system.
dimensions.evidence: Not less than once each year after the Secretary updates directives... the Secretary shall provide... training

missing_information: Total implementation cost and federal budget allocations
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to update medical facility directives, medical staffing, rape kit availability, training, and oversight regarding the management of acute sexual assault for veterans.

label: H.R. 5203
title: To direct the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to update directives of the Department of Veterans Affairs regarding the management of acute sexual assault, and for other purposes.
